name: Moon Sweepers VR
summary:
🌕 Welcome to the Lunar Surface Department!
The Moon is completely covered in dust, and you have been dispatched to clean it all up. Unfortunately, your starting budget only covered a single toothbrush. It’s time to roll up your virtual spacesuit sleeves and get to work!

Moon Sweepers VR brings the wildly popular lunar-cleaning concept into immersive virtual reality as a dedicated single-player experience. Physically scrub the terrain, collect valuable lunar dust, and sell it to fund your solo operation.
